statement: When Session.request or api.request is called with a URL that has no scheme (e.g. 'example.com/x'), users get a confusing low-level error. Make MissingSchema/InvalidSchema raise with a clear message that includes the invalid URL, consistent with how other invalid URLs are handled, without breaking existing tests.

CaseInsensitiveDict deletion during iteration can skip entries. Make deleting keys while iterating safe (document the semantics), and add the fix without changing the public API or breaking existing dict tests.
